onboarding.title: Welcome to Wispr Stories
onboarding.step1: Speak or type your message. Tap the microphone or paste text.
onboarding.step2: Customize your card: choose a tone, color, and corner style.
onboarding.step3: Create & share: download as PNG or share directly on social platforms.
onboarding.hint: Need help later? Open How to Use in the footer menu.
onboarding.refToggle: Switch modes: tap the mic icon to toggle between record and text mode.
onboarding.refVoice: Voice languages: 44 languages + auto-detect. Pick from the language button.
onboarding.refText: Text editing: the textarea accepts up to 150 characters. Edit freely.
onboarding.refTone: Tone rewriting: 6 tones. Free users get 5 per tone per day. Pro users get unlimited.
onboarding.refColor: Color: choose a palette to set the card background.
onboarding.refShape: Shape: sharp edges for messaging, rounded for galleries.
onboarding.refFontSize: Font size: bump the card text up for short messages.
